summary: Valvoline Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment refinances all Term B Loans by converting existing Initial Term B Loans into Refinanced Term B Loans on a cashless roll basis, with a new cash-funded portion used to repay non-converted loans. The aggregate principal remains $738,150,000, interest is SOFR plus 1.75% or base rate plus 0.75%, and quarterly amortization begins September 2026. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
